description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Resource_Eval, which implements a resource handler for Smarty templates that handles eval-based resources. It includes methods for populating source data, loading content, decoding encoded strings, building unique resource names, and determining the basename for compiled filenames.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Resource_Eval
classes.description: A class extending Smarty_Resource_Recompiled, providing methods for managing eval-based template resources, including loading, decoding, and resource identification.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the source object with meta data from the resource, setting a unique ID, filepath, and timestamp.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Loads the template's source content by decoding the resource name.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes base64 or URL-encoded strings in the resource name.

methods.name: buildUniqueResourceName
methods.description: Creates a unique resource name based on the class and decoded resource identifier.

methods.name: getBasename
methods.description: Returns an empty string as the basename for the resource.
